name: go-observability
description: > Structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, and health checks for Go services. Covers slog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and observability best practices. Use when: "add logging", "structured logs", "add tracing", "OpenTelemetry", "add metrics", "Prometheus", "observability", "instrument this code". Do NOT use for: performance profiling with pprof (use go-performance-review), error handling patterns (use go-error-handling), or health check endpoints (use go-api-design).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 一套面向 Go 服务的可观测性实践指南，适合接入结构化日志、分布式追踪和 Prometheus 指标。
